title: Morphing Tabs
description: Browser-style tabs on a liquid surface that flows into the active tab, with drag and keyboard reordering and optional close buttons.

loop.script: click[2] → wait → click[3] → wait → click[1] → wait

docs:
Installed `MorphingTabs`. Import it from `@/components/ui/morphing-tabs` and pass `items` (`id`, `label`, `content`, optional `icon` and `disabled`), with `value`/`onValueChange` for control, `onOrderChange` to keep a reordered list and `onClose` to show close buttons.

Tabs reorder by dragging or with Alt and the arrow keys; the arrows, Home and End move between tabs and select them. The rail never scrolls: tabs narrow to fit. It follows the reading direction and snaps instead of springing under reduced motion.

Ported from starc007/ui-components, beUI (MIT, copyright 2026 Saurabh Chauhan); the license text is in the file.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: React.ReactNode; content: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]

props.name: onOrderChange
props.description: Called once after a drag or keyboard reorder.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button on every tab.

props.name: classNames
props.type: { root?, rail?, tab?, activeTab?, icon?, label?, close?, content? }

a11y: The primitive's tabs pattern: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, roving focus, Arrow keys (in the reading direction), Home and End, automatic activation.
Alt+Arrow moves the focused tab; the order change is reported once through onOrderChange.
Close buttons are named "Close <label>" and sit outside the tablist, so the tablist owns only tabs.
Reduced motion: the springs and the liquid surface snap; panels cross-fade without blur or movement.
